Validate a results tibble against the ADR 0003 schema

Source: R/validate-results.R
validate_results_schema.Rd

Checks that tbl has all columns required by the results-CSV schema described in docs/adr/0003-results-csv-schema.md, and that context_variant and granularity only contain the enum values ADR 0003 fixes, and that include_headlines is logical. Does not check research_question, label, or score, since valid values for those are defined per-schema (see new_rq_schema()) rather than fixed by ADR 0003.

Usage

validate_results_schema(tbl)

Arguments

tbl

A tibble to validate, typically a results CSV read back from disk.

Value

tbl, invisibly, if valid. Otherwise throws an error naming the missing columns and/or invalid values found.
